body.statement: Construct \(R\) whenever \(G\equiv_E H\) and \(e\in E(H)\setminus E(G)\), transforming every \(\sigma\)-open walk in \(\operatorname{Lift}(G+e)\) given \(D(B,C)\) into one in \(\operatorname{Lift}(G)\) with the same endpoint copies and conditioning. The construction must cover SCC-changing arrows, directed self-loops, the two copywise and one cross-copy lifted edges generated by a bidirected loop, collider activation, SCC-tail changes, and first bidirected connections outside occupied SCC rectangles.
body.justification: This is the genuinely open proof mechanism.
body.gap: Only \(\mu\)-splicing and fixed-profile E-replacements are published.
body.consumer: It yields unrestricted transfer and certificates for optional edges.
